theorem_cards.label: One-sided asymmetric Hoeffding lemma Eq(17)
assumptions: EX=0, a<0<b, a≤X≤b a.s.; real s>0.
theorem_cards.statement: Eexp(sX)≤exp(s²v/2), v=|a|b if |a|≥b, and v=(b−a)²/4 if |a|≤b. The geometric coefficient is one-sided and swaps for−X.
proof_steps: ψ(0)=ψ′(0)=0,ψ″=τ(1−τ),τ=λ/[(1−λ)e^(−u)+λ]. Foru≥0,τ≥λ. Ifλ≥1/2 thenτ(1−τ)≤λ(1−λ), giving|a|b; else≤1/4 gives arithmetic mean squared.

theorem_cards.label: Safe sum bound Eq(23), source normalization errors
assumptions: Independent centered Xi∈[ai,bi] withai<0<bi; t>0; Mi² as precedingone-sided coefficient; Vplus=ΣMi²>0.
theorem_cards.statement: Eq(23) correctly givesP(Sn≥t)≤exp(−t²/(2Vplus)). For−Sn independently use Vminus=Σcoefficient(−bi,−ai), soP(|Sn|≥t)≤min(1,e^(−t²/(2Vplus))+e^(−t²/(2Vminus))). If Mbar²=Vplus/n, the exponent is−t²/(2nMbar²), not−n t²/(2Mbar²).
proof_steps: SourceEq(28)–(36) multiply byn after definingMbar²=Vplus/n: this reverses the normalization and cannot be used forSn=ΣXi. Counterexample n=2,iid±1,t=2: actualP(Sn≥2)=1/4, printedEq(31) yields exp(−4)<1/4; correctEq(23) gives exp(−1).
Two-sided source proof also prints event−Sn≤t in its union, which should be−Sn≥t.
gaps: Retain repaired formula as checked derivation, separate from literal source statement. Do not say all printed improved tail bounds are valid.
